status: Illustrative interface data; consistency checks do not validate successor finance
opening_policy: User chooses 0/25/50/75/100 percent of retained allocatable cash to invest
contribution_policy: All monthly budget remaining after required payment invested at month end, same policy for both examples
reserve_treatment: Allocatable capital only: costs separately funded and essential reserves outside this illustration; no reserve spent
source: Agent-authored fixed design assumptions under explicit owner authority; not market data or forecasts
validated: Debt/payment from existing M1; cash growth primitive from existing M4
illustrative: Opening split, recurring contributions and authored investment path
precision: Decimal 50; display ROUND_HALF_UP; gains and repaid principal are residuals of displayed totals
exclusions: No tax, fees, inflation, withdrawals, rate reset, property appreciation, optimisation or probabilities
